content.text:
TauCeti has a general Tate module over a separably closed field (not yet a Galois representation over a number field). It's more than "local Tate module". My ledger phrase "TauCeti has the local Tate module and Serre's local lemma only" is inaccurate: TauCeti has the Tate module (general, over separably closed field) and Serre's lemma for local fields, but no Galois representation over number fields/open image. The Lean header section 3 says "TauCeti has TauCeti/.../TateModule/ (Tate module, Serre's local lemma, potential good reduction) but no global open-image theorem" — accurate.

Fix the ledger phrase to "TauCeti has the Tate module over separably closed fields, Serre's local lemma and potential good reduction, but no global open-image theorem". Also the header's "no l-adic Tate module" was corrected. Let's patch ledger.
